texts.value: Iron transport multicopper ferroxidase required for Fe(2+) ion high affinity uptake. Required to oxidize Fe(2+) to Fe(3+), which is then transported into the cell via the ferric iron permease FTR1. Essential component of copper-dependent iron transport. Also has cuprous oxidase activity (PubMed:14623105)
kcat is 79.2 min(-1) and 63.9 min(-1) with Cu(+) and Fe(2+) as substrates, respectively.
By iron deprivation. Repressed by iron excess
Present with 1050 molecules/cell in log phase SD medium
Belongs to the multicopper oxidase family

features.description: Loss of ferroxidase and cuproxidase activities.
